message: The task editor now reads the title the same way quick add does. A pasted link, phone number or email, a priority or project token, a timer, estimate, daily target, "after sunset", "unless it rains", "after <task>", subtasks and "Don't ..." are each offered as a tap-to-apply suggestion under the title. A date phrase with a time also offers a reminder and keeps its time window and extra dates.
